CommunityApplications.Profile:
X-ONU-SFPP Dashboard provides a lightweight Unraid Docker application for monitoring EXEN X-ONU-SFPP and compatible XGS-PON ONTs running 8311 community firmware.
It displays live and historical optical power, temperatures, module voltage, TX bias, PLOAM state, and ONT connectivity.
Project source, documentation, and issue tracking are available on GitHub.
